services.name: Docent Program
services.desc: To become a docent, all you need is enthusiasm, time, energy, a good speaking voice, and a love of people. And the Hudson River Museum loves its docents! Please join us. For those who are interested in volunteer opportunities at the HRM but cannot make the time commitment that the Docent Program requires, please visit our Career & Volunteer Opportunities page. DOCENT, noun, from Latin docent-, docens, present participle of docere: A person who leads guided tours especially through a museum or art gallery. services.name: Museum Rentals
services.desc: With its unique fusion of modern and historic architecture, the Hudson River Museum is the perfect artful setting to host your next event. The HRM accommodates rentals of all sizes, from large milestone celebrations to intimate dinners, and everything in between, including birthday parties, corporate meetings and conferences, photo and film shoots, and more. Browse through our offerings and submit a request using an inquiry form below. Book a wedding or special event in the Hudson Room, our largest space, with an adjoining terrace and beautiful views of the Hudson and Palisades. services.name: Class of 2026
services.desc: The HRM Teaching Artists-in-Residence and Teaching Scientists-in-Residence are outside professionals who work with the Museum to create programs that enhance the historic, artistic, or literary themes of the current exhibitions or the Museum’s permanent collections. The Museum’s distinctive residency program gives emerging artists and scientists the unique opportunity to develop their practice while providing meaningful and accessible community outreach that connects visitors to the art on view and facilitates understanding, while effecting social and environmental equity through the power of the visual, performing, and/or literary arts.
